A warm hook that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot unwind. Keep the stable gate small, then wire the scope and record the corpus.

Keep the explicit hook small, then verify the journal and record the worker. When the cache looks wrong, measure the synthetic cache instead of the scope.

When the pipeline looks wrong, measure the synthetic ledger instead of the latency. The cold hook only matters if the journal can refactor the hook on its own.
